prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Italian woman, fair light skin with a faint warm undertone, late 40s silver fox goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, silver-white low chignon knot at the nape — full body Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold formations — a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, BLAZING GOLD and VIVID CRIMSON bands following every deep curve of her body, dense folk-art floral motifs filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A light smudge of soot marks her cheek and jawline, and a little soot dusts her fingertips, the backs of her hands and her bare feet. Her expression is a calm, distant gaze. Restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the flagstones beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the flagstones, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long coffin chrome nails gold crimson tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
